note_index_intents_claim_complete.name: note_index_intents_claim_complete
note_index_intents_claim_complete.value: ("note_index_intents"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "note_index_intents"."run_id" IS NULL AND "note_index_intents"."runtime_url" IS NULL AND "note_index_intents"."claimed_at" IS NULL) OR ("note_index_intents"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "note_index_intents"."runtime_url" IS NOT NULL AND "note_index_intents"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL)

organize_runs_terminal_content.name: organize_runs_terminal_content
organize_runs_terminal_content.value: "organize_runs"."active" OR ("organize_runs"."input" IS NULL AND "organize_runs"."runtime" IS NULL AND "organize_runs"."cleanup_target" IS NULL AND "organize_runs"."state"->>'status' NOT IN ('running', 'draft', 'cleaning'))

conversation_citations_redaction_valid.name: conversation_citations_redaction_valid
conversation_citations_redaction_valid.value: ("conversation_citations"."deleted" AND "conversation_citations"."excerpt" IS NULL) OR (NOT "conversation_citations"."deleted" AND "conversation_citations"."excerpt" IS NOT NULL AND length("conversation_citations"."excerpt") > 0)

conversation_contexts_content_valid.name: conversation_contexts_content_valid
conversation_contexts_content_valid.value: ("conversation_contexts"."state" = 'summarizing' AND "conversation_contexts"."summary_input" IS NOT NULL) OR ("conversation_contexts"."state" <> 'summarizing' AND "conversation_contexts"."summary_input" IS NULL)

conversation_messages_role_valid.name: conversation_messages_role_valid
conversation_messages_role_valid.value: ("conversation_messages"."role" = 'user' AND "conversation_messages"."turn_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_messages"."role" = 'assistant' AND "conversation_messages"."turn_id" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_messages_policy_valid.name: conversation_messages_policy_valid
conversation_messages_policy_valid.value: ("conversation_messages"."role" = 'user' AND "conversation_messages"."delivery_policy" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_messages"."delivery_policy" IN ('queue', 'steer')) OR ("conversation_messages"."role" = 'assistant' AND "conversation_messages"."delivery_policy" IS NULL)

conversation_turns_reason_valid.name: conversation_turns_reason_valid
conversation_turns_reason_valid.value: ("conversation_turns"."status" = 'incomplete' AND "conversation_turns"."reason" IN ('failed', 'cancelled') AND "conversation_turns"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("conversation_turns"."status" <> 'incomplete' AND "conversation_turns"."reason" IS NULL)

conversation_turns_runtime_complete.name: conversation_turns_runtime_complete
conversation_turns_runtime_complete.value: ("conversation_turns"."allocation_operation_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_turns"."runtime_url" IS NULL AND "conversation_turns"."session_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_turns"."allocation_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_turns"."runtime_url" IS NOT NULL)
